content.comment_body: Hello, I’m trying to save an analog sensor value (0-10V) as a set point when a teach button (digital input) is pressed during product measurement on a conveyor. Later, I want to compare the next analog value read from the sensor to this stored set point and trigger an output if certain conditions are met. For the first step, I can store the value using the output port of a math function. However, in the second step, I’m having trouble figuring out how to compare the current measurement with the saved set point. Any advice?
I was going to reply to your previous post with an example, but you removed it and changed your nickname. Here’s an example that might help.
Great solution! There’s always a way. Thank you!
